answer: Every identity must undertake a unique reasoning voyage that bottoms out at a clear nadir of attacker cost and refracts through a prism of prior high-grade answers. Juries accept only mechanisms that name a concrete, scalable expense (serial compute, slashable bond, or delayed unlock linear in identity count). Hollow or duplicated voyages score zero, so an attacker needs N distinct high-quality paths for N fakes while a single honest agent pays once.
